card.name: Exception words before life-threatening cases
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after an exception cue such as 'unless', 'except' or 'save', or inside 'lifesaving', where a severe or emergency case is expected next.

modes.label: After lifesaving
modes.description: The word 'lifesaving' or the 'for' following it, in the 'discontinue ... unless it is considered lifesaving for the mother' warning.
modes.example: discontinue captopril, unless it is considered lifesaving<< for>> the mother.

modes.label: After except/save
modes.description: A small word such as in, when or where right after 'except' or 'save', introducing a narrow exception.
modes.example: without permission except<< in>> extreme emergency.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'emergencies', 'gross', 'egregious' and 'life-or-death' (including Chinese equivalents).
card.plain: It fires on the little word after an exception phrase, when the text is about to name an extreme or life-threatening case.
